svg.title: Secret athlete: turnaround and measuring guide (original design, not artwork)
svg.text: Original design. Flat proportion and colour guide for building and checking the 3D model (docs/tezuka-character.md). Not concept art, not a 3D asset.
paddle in his LEFT hand in every view
• Narrow calm eyes, lids slightly lowered
• Level brows, close to the eyes
• Closed level mouth: no smile at rest
• Fringe in 4–5 locks to the glasses
Shirt: royal blue body, white sleeves and collar band
Navy diagonal panel, his left shoulder → right hip,
4 mm silver-grey edge; original chevron crest, no text
Shorts: white, mid-thigh, 25 mm navy side stripe
Navy wristband on the LEFT wrist; white crew socks
Court shoes: white, navy heel and toe guard, gum sole
Knees soft, weight on the balls of the feet
Paddle at chest height, face to the net, LEFT hand
Right hand near the paddle throat
the palm, thumb over, index slightly spread
